title: A New Caregiver, A New Routine (Megan's Watch)
summary: As Thanksgiving break ends on Monday, November 30, 2015, and the college students return to CPI for the final weeks of the semester, Zoë's newly single twenty-seven-year-old sister Megan takes over the daytime watch at 414 Geneva Street. Over morning hugs, side-by-side 'work buddy' days at the dining table, heart-healthy meals in solidarity, and a single-handed shower transfer, a slow-burning mutual attraction blooms between Jordan and Megan—leading to Jordan's ENG 102 campus accessibility proposal, Zoë's explicit permission for her sister to explore her feelings, and Jordan's first post-op restaurant outing to The Smokin' Anvil.
